name: Small Cheese 2019

venue.name: [Sugar Creek Bible Camp](https://wp.sugarcreekbiblecamp.org/)
venue.address: Sugar Creek Bible Camp Road, Ferryville, WI 54628
venue.details: The Manna Center (MC) 1/2 mile back, keep left.

information: Parking is very limited: please carpool if at all possible. See the "Venue Information" tab for more info. Beef soup will be provided for everyone at the competition. There is no internet service at the venue, and cell reception will be poor if available at all. On the spot registration fees must be paid in cash. The main event of this competiton is 3x3 With Feet. We will also be holding an unofficial round of 4x4 With Feet.
